visualtest_layout_baseline-align.md.msg: baseline-align fixture locked into corpus to lock the true-baseline placement

EVERY LytParagraph on the page must satisfy y>=111 (attr = every-node universal). The baseline row's text children sit at y=114 post-layout (measured; first-line baselines 125.9, within tolerance of the BlockImage bottom edge 126, collinear within divided-by-scale plus truncation precision); all Expected/body paragraphs are further down. y>=111 proves the text was shifted DOWN onto the image baseline by the post-layout: pre-fix bottom-degradation leaves text at y=109, center around 85, start around 67, all FAIL. NOTE: adding any LytParagraph above y=111 (e.g. page-top intro) legitimately FAILS this rule, so recalibrate then. EXEMPTION protocol: second-pass geometry intentionally deviates from the raw taffy writeback for this BASELINE container (taffy 0.12.1 first_baselines always NONE); non-BASELINE containers are byte-identical. Tolerance 3px per measured evidence (bug margin 5px).
